description: This file defines the MeetingsViewEdit class, which extends the ViewEdit class to customize the editing view for 'Meetings' in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for pre-display operations and rendering the edit view, managing JSON configurations, and reminders data.

classes.name: MeetingsViewEdit
classes.description: A class that customizes the edit view for Meeting records, handling pre-display setup and rendering of the edit interface, including JSON configurations and reminders.

methods.name: preDisplay
methods.description: Overrides the parent method to check for a 'status' parameter in the request to support the 'Close And Create New' operation.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the edit view, setting up JSON configurations and reminders data, and managing duplicate records.
